title: CAT 2025 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Aptitude - Percentages
subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.q: Kamala divided her investment of Rs 100000 between stocks, bonds, and gold. Her investment in bonds was 25% of her investment in gold. With annual returns of 10%, 6%, 8% on stocks, bonds, and gold, respectively, she gained a total amount of Rs 8200 in one year. The amount, in rupees, that she gained from the bonds, was
questions.explain:
Let investments in stocks, bonds, and gold be $S$, $B$, and $G$.
Given $B = 0.25G$, so $G = 4B$.
Total Investment: $S + B + G = 100000 \implies S + 5B = 100000 \implies S = 100000 - 5B$.
Total Return: $0.10S + 0.06B + 0.08G = 8200$.
Substitute $S$ and $G$ in terms of $B$:
$0.10(100000 - 5B) + 0.06B + 0.08(4B) = 8200$
$10000 - 0.50B + 0.06B + 0.32B = 8200$
$10000 - 0.12B = 8200 \implies 0.12B = 1800 \implies B = \frac{1800}{0.12} = 15000$.
Amount gained from bonds = $0.06B = 0.06 \times 15000 = 900$.
